title: 第一卷 第1章 族长顾天阳第一卷 第2章 绑定不朽家族系统
slug: 我为族长当缔造诸天万界之禁忌家族
content_zh:
大乾王朝。
青云城。
顾家的一处幽静石室内，灵气氤氲。
石室中央的蒲团上。
一个面容尚显稚嫩的少年睁开了双眼，瞳孔深处，倒映着一种茫然。
“这是哪里？”
突然，一股源自灵魂深处撕裂般的痛楚，如同潮水般汹涌袭来。
“呃啊！”
顾天阳闷哼一声，双手死死抱住头。
这不是**的疼痛，而是两种记忆在他的灵魂中交汇融合。
顾天阳的意识几度濒临崩溃的边缘，仅凭着一股顽强的求生本能死死支撑着。
大约一炷香的时间，那狂暴的记忆潮汐渐渐平息。
痛楚如退潮般减弱，只留下满身的虚弱感。
顾天阳缓缓松开抱头的双手，胸膛剧烈起伏，大口喘息着，带着劫后余生的庆幸。
“我这是穿越了？”
他低声呢喃，声音沙哑，带着一丝难以置信的苦涩。
通过刚才那场惊心动魄的记忆融合，他已然知晓了一切。
这里是大乾王朝。
疆域辽阔，强者为尊。
他所在之地，是天源府下辖的青云城。

而他现在的身份。
是青云城四大家族之一。
顾家的族长，顾天阳。
年仅十八岁，便已执掌一族之权，看似位高权重，实则如履薄冰。
一切变故，皆源于一个月前。
那时，顾家是青云城四大家族之首，风头无两，威压全城。
原因无他。
只因顾家的上任族长顾青山，也就是原身的父亲，乃是一位货真价实的凝气境九层巅峰强者。
一身修为更是力压王、李、赵三大家族，便是连城主府，也要对其礼让三分。
然而，天有不测风云。
一月前，顾青山为寻求突破灵海境的契机，深入青云城附近那危机四伏的青云山脉深处。
不料，此一去。
竟如泥牛入海，再无音讯。
家族倾尽全力，搜寻半月之久。
却如同石沉大海，连一丝有用的线索都未曾找到。
甚至连顾青山是生是死，都无从判断。
最终，在大长老顾青云的主持下。
家族不得不无奈接受现实，认定族长已然遇难。
然而，一族不可无主。
尤其是在这强敌环伺之际。

顾家内部，虽悲痛万分，却也极为团结。
原身天赋卓绝，年仅十八岁，修为便已达聚气境九层。
实力足以比肩家族中的老一辈人物。
潜力更是远超同辈，被视为家族未来的希望。
content_en:
Daqian Dynasty.
Qingyun City.
A quiet stone room in the Gu family is filled with spiritual energy.
On the futon in the center of the stone room.
A young boy with an immature face opened his eyes, a kind of confusion reflected in the depths of his pupils.
"Where is this?"
Suddenly, a tearing pain from the depths of his soul surged over him like a tidal wave.
"Uh-huh!"
Gu Tianyang groaned and held his head tightly with both hands.
This was not the pain of his body, but the intersection and fusion of two memories in his soul.
Gu Tianyang's consciousness was on the verge of collapse several times, and he was only supported by a tenacious survival instinct.
In about one stick of incense, the violent tide of memory gradually subsided.
The pain subsided like an ebbing tide, leaving only a feeling of weakness all over the body.
Gu Tianyang slowly let go of his hands holding his head, his chest heaved violently, and he gasped for air, feeling grateful to have survived the disaster.
"Have I traveled through time?"
He whispered in a low voice, his voice hoarse, with a hint of incredible bitterness.
Through the thrilling memory fusion just now, he already knew everything.
This is the Daqian Dynasty.
The territory is vast and the strong are respected.
The place where he is located is Qingyun City under the jurisdiction of Tianyuan Mansion.
And his current identity.
It is one of the four major families in Qingyun City.
The patriarch of the Gu family, Gu Tianyang.
At only eighteen years old, he has already taken charge of the clan. He seems to be in a high and powerful position, but in fact he is walking on thin ice.
All the changes originated a month ago.
At that time, the Gu family was the head of the four major families in Qingyun City, with unrivaled prominence and power over the entire city.
There is no other reason.
Just because the previous patriarch of the Gu family, Gu Qingshan, who was the original father, was a genuine and powerful person at the ninth level of the Qi Condensation Realm.
His cultivation is even more powerful than the three major families of Wang, Li, and Zhao. Even the city lord's palace must show courtesy to him.
However, there are unforeseen circumstances.
One month ago, Gu Qingshan went deep into the dangerous Qingyun Mountains near Qingyun City in order to seek an opportunity to break through the spiritual sea realm.
Unexpectedly, this one is gone.
It was like a mud cow drowning in the sea, never heard from again.
The family put all their efforts into searching for half a month.
But it was like a stone sinking into the sea, and not even a single useful clue was found.
There was no way to even tell whether Gu Qingshan was alive or dead.
Finally, under the auspices of the great elder Gu Qingyun.
The family had no choice but to accept the reality and concluded that the patriarch had been killed.
However, a clan cannot be without its owner.
Especially when powerful enemies are around.
Although the Gu family is extremely sad, they are also extremely united.
The original person was extremely talented. At the age of only eighteen, his cultivation had already reached the ninth level of Qi Gathering Realm.
His strength is comparable to that of the older generation in the family.
His potential is far beyond that of his peers, and he is regarded as the hope of the family's future.
